completed_passage:
On Friday afternoon, our class has Book Share in the library. We bring books that we can lend to friends. Our teacher, Miss Liu, is there to help. She looks at the books with us and helps us put them on a long table. We do not put them on the floor.

Ben brings two picture books. One is about a train, and the other is about a little dog. Amy wants to borrow the train book. She asks Ben first, and he says yes. She will return it next Friday. She is borrowing the book, not keeping it as a gift.

Before our friends choose books, we make small cards. We write each book owner’s name on a card. These cards tell readers whom to ask before borrowing. We put a card beside each book. At the end, we write down which books our friends have borrowed. The list will help us find them when it is time to give them back.
